# YOOV WORK | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| HKSME Pay | Hong Kong ' s SME pay is validated on the main link "People ' s or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - self-help for staff managers - results into the report or downstream system " . It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| Retailing/services scheduling | The main link to validate retailing/services was used as the “people or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - employee manager self-help - results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| Electronicization of paper approvals | Electronicization of paper approvals using the main link as “entry of personnel or candidate data - rules or approval processing - self-help of staff managers - results into reports or downstream systems”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| Staff self-help | The main link to verify the employee's self-help is “the entry of person or candidate data - the rules or approval process - the self-help of the staff manager - the entry of results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
